adoption.gap_and_reason: Reuse existing exact observations; never transplant latest-slot extraction.
Missing health/stamps and stale slots violate exact cohort contract.
Versioned caller thresholds, bounded windows, explicit gaps and immutable facts.
Transition is fact; dissatisfaction/cause requires separate feedback. Override veto stays.
No causal evidence that a pedal/steer transition expresses discomfort.
Pin unit/consumer/hash and ownership; UI ranges cannot be safety bounds.
Structured pinned claims with explicit conditions, not stale raw snippets.
Useful symptom vocabulary; fixed numbers and fabricated fallback values rejected.
No network approval, privacy contract or qualified identification.
No owner transaction, causal approval or verified recovery.
UX_CONCEPT_ONLY; distinguish requested, committed, verified and uncertain outcomes.
Provider labels only; credential synchronization/persistence not adopted.
FUTURE_LONGITUDINAL_EPISODE vocabulary only; no roadmap activation.
Human-visible proposed differences are useful; default checked selection not authority.

episodes.name: departure_start
episodes.formula: previous.standstill AND NOT current.standstill AND current.hasLead
episodes.units: speed km/h; distance m; acceleration m/s^2
episodes.override: No driver exclusion; isOverride=False is a label, not proof of automation
episodes.false_positive: Manual departure or lost standstill bit looks automated
episodes.false_negative: 5Hz transition or skipped segment may hide start
episodes.cohort_risk: Latest-value slots, event timestamp not source identity; adjacent sampled/disjoint segments are not a continuous synchronized episode.

episodes.name: harsh_catchup_accel
episodes.formula: hasLead AND aTarget >= 1.4 AND NOT gas
episodes.override: Gas excluded only; brake/steer/engagement not gated
episodes.false_positive: Ordinary required acceleration or stale lead looks harsh
episodes.false_negative: Subsampled short pulse or unavailable target default hides surge
episodes.cohort_risk: Latest-value slots, event timestamp not source identity; adjacent sampled/disjoint segments are not a continuous synchronized episode.

episodes.name: harsh_decel
episodes.override: Brake excluded only; steering/gas/engagement not gated
episodes.false_negative: Brake override excludes genuine harsh automated lead-in
episodes.cohort_risk: Latest-value slots, event timestamp not source identity; adjacent sampled/disjoint segments are not a continuous synchronized episode.

episodes.name: steering_tracking_error
episodes.formula: vEgo >= 30 AND abs(desiredSteerAngle - steerAngle) >= 3 AND NOT steer
episodes.units: speed km/h; angle degree; normalized torque
episodes.override: Steer excluded only; no lateral-active/controller-kind guard
episodes.false_positive: Default/unsupported target angle or inactive controller creates apparent error
episodes.false_negative: Brief errors between samples or intervention excludes a real deviation
episodes.cohort_risk: Latest-value slots, event timestamp not source identity; adjacent sampled/disjoint segments are not a continuous synchronized episode.

episodes.name: curve_speed_mismatch
episodes.formula: vEgo >= 30 AND max(abs(steerAngle),abs(desiredSteerAngle)) >= 15 AND 0 < abs(vTurnSpeed) < vEgo-5 AND (desiredSpeed >= vEgo-1 OR desiredSource != vturn)
episodes.false_positive: A safer/lower model or route target still triggers source-not-vturn clause
episodes.false_negative: Absent/default vTurnSpeed prevents detection; no chosen-source legitimacy
episodes.cohort_risk: Latest-value slots, event timestamp not source identity; adjacent sampled/disjoint segments are not a continuous synchronized episode.

episodes.name: driver_brake_override
episodes.formula: include_driver_override AND brake rising edge AND vEgo >= 5
episodes.units: speed km/h; acceleration m/s^2; distance m
episodes.override: Explicit inclusion; not an admissible learning sample
episodes.false_negative: At-rest intervention or sampling/segment gap loses transition
episodes.cohort_risk: Latest-value slots, event timestamp not source identity; adjacent sampled/disjoint segments are not a continuous synchronized episode.

episodes.name: driver_gas_override
episodes.formula: include_driver_override AND gas rising edge AND vEgo <= 80
episodes.units: speed km/h; acceleration m/s^2; distance m
episodes.false_positive: Manual acceleration/preferences become alleged sluggish automation
episodes.false_negative: Above-80 intervention or short pulse omitted
episodes.cohort_risk: Latest-value slots, event timestamp not source identity; adjacent sampled/disjoint segments are not a continuous synchronized episode.

episodes.name: driver_steer_override
episodes.formula: include_driver_override AND steer rising edge AND vEgo >= 20
episodes.override: Explicit inclusion; no exact producer/active evidence
episodes.false_positive: Lane positioning or unrelated takeover becomes alleged tracking fault
episodes.false_negative: Low-speed intervention or short pulse omitted
episodes.cohort_risk: Latest-value slots, event timestamp not source identity; adjacent sampled/disjoint segments are not a continuous synchronized episode.

scores.rationale: Useful vocabulary; synchronized inputs and causal labels need stronger contracts.
Descriptors are reusable; defaults and some unit labels disagree with consumers.
Readable hypotheses useful; certainty and numeric fallback not evidence.
Diff/confirmation useful; snapshot replay is not verified recovery.
Latest slots/default coercion and route coupling unsuitable for exact runtime.
Fixed targets and free-text defaults lack qualification and privacy gates.

score_scale: 0..5 ordinal architecture judgment, not measured safety; larger coupling/risk is worse, larger other axes is better.

source_grounding_checks.reason: Call/min expressions exist; alive guard and full eco state omitted.
Vision candidate excluded but independent model and other candidates remain, even mode 0.
Additional speed >20, target reset and exit guards absent from synopsis.
At the shown min point lower candidate wins; later intentional gas-floor changes target/source.
Default linear consumer divides factor; NN/brand modes prevent universal direction.
CruiseMaxVals1 prompt fallback 200 vs catalog160; DynamicTFollow30 vs0; StopDistance450 vs600; Ki/Kf title scaling differs from consumers.
